tool_input.command:
cd /workspace
cat > tmp/ip-policy-forms/gen.py << 'PYEOF'
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, copy

RE_MASK = r'^(254|252|248|240|224|192|128)\.0\.0\.0$|^255\.(254|252|248|240|224|192|128|0)\.0\.0$|^255\.255\.(254|252|248|240|224|192|128|0)\.0$|^255\.255\.255\.(254|252|248|240|224|192|128|0|255)$'
RE_GW   = r'^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|[01]?\d?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|[01]?\d?\d)$'
RE_VLAN = r'^([1-9]\d{0,2}|[1-3]\d{3}|40[0-8]\d|409[0-4])$'

def make_col(tpl, key, label, model_field, y, pattern, ph, note):
    c = copy.deepcopy(tpl)
    c['key'] = key; c['label'] = label; c['modelField'] = model_field
    o = c['options']
    o['layout'][1] = y
    o['required'] = True
    o['pattern'] = pattern
    o['isEnablePattern'] = True
    o['placeholder'] = ph
    o['note'] = note
    o['defaultValue'] = ''
    return c

def add_three(fd, container_key, after_model_field):
    """在 table 容器指定列后插 子网掩码/路由地址/VlanID 三列，后续 y 顺延。"""
    for c in fd:
        if c.get('key') != container_key:
            continue
        props = c['propertys']
        tpl = None; pos = None
        for i, p in enumerate(props):
            if p['modelField'] == after_model_field:
                tpl = p; pos = i
        assert tpl is not None, after_model_field
        sec = tpl.get('belongToSection')
        cols = [
            make_col(tpl, 'cmp_net_mask',  '子网掩码', 'netMask',  pos + 1, RE_MASK,
                     '如 255.255.255.0', '合法掩码（点分十进制）'),
            make_col(tpl, 'cmp_route_addr', '路由地址', 'routeAddr', pos + 2, RE_GW,
                     '如 192.168.1.254', '网关 IPv4 地址'),
            make_col(tpl, 'cmp_vlan_id',   'VlanID',   'vlanId',   pos + 3, RE_VLAN,
                     '1-4094', 'VLAN 编号 1-4094'),
        ]
        for col in cols:
            col['belongToSection'] = sec
        props[pos + 1:pos + 1] = cols
        for i, p in enumerate(props):
            p['options']['layout'][1] = i
        return fd
    raise AssertionError(container_key)

# ① 处理表单：IP地址申请 table，插在 IP 列后
fd = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/ip-policy-forms/form-chuli.definition.json'))
add_three(fd, 'hhrsezf08y', 'hhrsezf090')
json.dump(fd, open('/workspace/tmp/ip-policy-forms/form-chuli-v2.definition.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
json.dump({'name': 'IP地址及访问策略申请_处理', 'category': '服务管理', 'memo': '',
           'formDefinition': json.dumps(fd, ensure_ascii=False), 'state': 'done',
           'versionName': '1.0.1', 'versionMemo': '加子网掩码路由VlanID'},
          open('/workspace/tmp/ip-policy-forms/form-chuli-v2.body.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False)

# ② 发起表单：新增主机 table，插在 IP 列后
fd2 = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/ip-policy-forms/form-faqi.definition.json'))
add_three(fd2, 'hhry6silnb', 'hhrydc4aox')
json.dump(fd2, open('/workspace/tmp/ip-policy-forms/form-faqi-v2.definition.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
json.dump({'name': '基础环境资源申请表-发起', 'category': '服务管理', 'memo': '',
           'formDefinition': json.dumps(fd2, ensure_ascii=False), 'state': 'done',
           'versionName': '1.0.12', 'versionMemo': '加子网掩码路由VlanID'},
          open('/workspace/tmp/ip-policy-forms/form-faqi-v2.body.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False)
print('两表单新版本已生成')

# 正则自验
import re
assert re.match(RE_MASK, '255.255.255.0') and re.match(RE_MASK, '255.255.0.0') and re.match(RE_MASK, '255.0.0.0')
assert not re.match(RE_MASK, '255.255.255.1') and not re.match(RE_MASK, '192.168.1.0')
assert re.match(RE_GW, '192.168.1.254') and re.match(RE_GW, '10.0.0.1') and not re.match(RE_GW, '256.1.1.1') and not re.match(RE_GW, '1.1.1')
assert re.match(RE_VLAN, '1') and re.match(RE_VLAN, '999') and re.match(RE_VLAN, '4094')
assert not re.match(RE_VLAN, '0') and not re.match(RE_VLAN, '4095') and not re.match(RE_VLAN, '01')
print('正则自验通过')
PYEOF
python3 tmp/ip-policy-forms/gen.py

python3 /workspace/.api-orchestrator/platforms/easyops/formats/form-kit/form-validator.py check-version --version "1.0.1" --memo "加子网掩码路由VlanID" 2>&1 | tail -1
